entries.title: Exodus 25:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 25:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering. {bring me: Heb. take for me} {offering: or, heave offering}

words.text: . {bring me: Heb. take for me} {offering: or, heave offering}

entries.title: Exodus 25:3
segments: And this [is] the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass, {offering: or, heave offering}

entries.title: Exodus 25:4
segments: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' [hair], {fine...: or, silk}

entries.title: Exodus 25:5
segments: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

entries.title: Exodus 25:6
segments: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

entries.title: Exodus 25:7
segments: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

entries.title: Exodus 25:8
segments: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:9
segments: According to all that I shew thee, [after] the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make [it].

words.text: According to all that I shew
thereof, even so shall ye make

entries.title: Exodus 25:10
segments: ¶And they shall make an ark [of] shittim wood: two cubits and a half [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

entries.title: Exodus 25:11
segments: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

entries.title: Exodus 25:12
segments: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put [them] in the four corners thereof; and two rings [shall be] in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:13
segments: And thou shalt make staves [of] shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:14
segments: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:15
segments: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:16
segments: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

entries.title: Exodus 25:17
segments: And thou shalt make a mercy seat [of] pure gold: two cubits and a half [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

entries.title: Exodus 25:18
segments: And thou shalt make two cherubims [of] gold, [of] beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

entries.title: Exodus 25:19
segments: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: [even] of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof. {of...: or, of the matter of the mercy seat}

words.text: thereof. {of...: or, of the matter of the mercy seat}

entries.title: Exodus 25:20
segments: And the cherubims shall stretch forth [their] wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces [shall look] one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

entries.title: Exodus 25:21
segments: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

entries.title: Exodus 25:22
segments: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which [are] upon the ark of the testimony, of all [things] which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

words.text: with thee, and I will commune
with thee from above the mercy seat
, of all [things] which I will give thee in commandment

entries.title: Exodus 25:23
segments: ¶Thou shalt also make a table [of] shittim wood: two cubits [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

entries.title: Exodus 25:24
segments: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

entries.title: Exodus 25:25
segments: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

entries.title: Exodus 25:26
segments: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that [are] on the four feet thereof.

entries.title: Exodus 25:27
segments: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

entries.title: Exodus 25:28
segments: And thou shalt make the staves [of] shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:29
segments: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: [of] pure gold shalt thou make them. {to...: or, to pour out withal}

words.text: them. {to...: or, to pour out withal}

entries.title: Exodus 25:30
segments: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

entries.title: Exodus 25:31
segments: ¶And thou shalt make a candlestick [of] pure gold: [of] beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

entries.title: Exodus 25:32
segments: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

entries.title: Exodus 25:33
segments: Three bowls made like unto almonds, [with] a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, [with] a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

entries.title: Exodus 25:34
segments: And in the candlestick [shall be] four bowls made like unto almonds, [with] their knops and their flowers.

entries.title: Exodus 25:35
segments: And [there shall be] a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

words.text: of the same, and a knop
of the same, and a knop
of the same, according to the six

entries.title: Exodus 25:36
segments: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it [shall be] one beaten work [of] pure gold.

words.text: shall be of the same: all it [shall be] one

entries.title: Exodus 25:37
segments: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it. {shall light: or, shall cause to ascend} {it: Heb. the face of it}

words.text: thereof, that they may give light
. {shall light: or, shall cause to ascend} {it: Heb. the face of it}

entries.title: Exodus 25:38
segments: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, [shall be of] pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:39
segments: [Of] a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

entries.title: Exodus 25:40
segments: And look that thou make [them] after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount. {which...: Heb. which thou wast caused to see}

words.text: . {which...: Heb. which thou wast caused to see}
